mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_attachment a JOIN question q ON q.current_revision_id=a.revision_id JOIN question_bank b ON b.id=q.bank_id JOIN subject s ON s.id=b.subject_id WHERE a.file_id=#{fileId} AND q.status='ACTIVE' AND b.status='ACTIVE' AND b.publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND s.status='ACTIVE')
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM question_attachment a JOIN practice_item i ON i.revision_id=a.revision_id JOIN practice_session s ON s.id=i.session_id WHERE a.file_id=#{fileId} AND s.user_id=#{userId})
